messages: October 6 market-context, overnight movement, Treasury-yield and key-level tables were refreshed. ES values were added from a successful TradingView 1-minute futures history retrieval at 2026-10-06T15:35:49Z; each row retains the actual observation timestamp.

Robinhood supplied SPY and QQQ one-minute extended-hours bars through 09:19 ET and official October 5 settled closes. TradingView supplied timestamped ES, NQ, YM, RTY, VIX and Treasury-yield bars. Other retained quotes came from their previously successful retrievals; see per-row timestamps and issues.

TradingView warns its bars may be delayed 15+ minutes depending on exchange. Public.com returned UNKNOWN for Treasury yield symbols, so TradingView was used as the approved fallback.

indices.title: Equity Commentary
indices.body:
Oil is trading at around $86, below the $88 key technical level. While oil exports have rebounded strongly since the start of the war, the combination of reduced pre-Iran refining capacity and oil shippers paying highly elevated risk premiums to ship their goods is contributing to a rise in energy prices.

Yesterday we printed a very bullish candle. My personal bias is bullish, and I would focus more on longs than shorts, so long as key support levels are held. QQQ has made consistent all-time highs while the S&P 500 has lagged, making higher lows along the way and now sitting well within 1% of its all-time high.

That being said, breadth is still weak, with some sign of recovery underway. Tech is the strongest, while industrials and materials are showing more strength than other non-tech sectors.

As mentioned before, the rate story, uncertainty around midterms and the potential for an Iran deal continue to be primary drivers of price action. Equities are defying high energy prices and elevated bond yields.

bonds.title: Bond Commentary
bonds.body:
Treasury yields made a new high yesterday at 5.32%.

France's national debt is driving consistent concern, with French 10-year yields cooling from 4.95% to 4.75% but still comparatively high.
